name: Fatal Force : The Tragedy of The Lone Wolf Arc
source:
A student who was attacked by a wild werewolf was saved by another werewolf who is a werewolf's slayer. But, unfortunately, the student had been bitten, and they must find out the werewolf's identity who bitten the student before the full moon rises. In search of identity, they counter many weird things and lead them to the unexpected truth.

[From [url=https://darkdragon563.itch.io/fatal-force-the-tragedy-of-the-lone-wolf-arc]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名学生遭野生狼人袭击，幸得另一名狼人救下，而救他的正是一位猎杀狼人的狼人杀手。可惜学生已经被咬伤，他们必须赶在满月升起之前查明咬伤学生的狼人的身份。寻找真相的途中，他们遭遇许多怪事，并最终走向意料之外的真相。

[来源：[url=https://darkdragon563.itch.io/fatal-force-the-tragedy-of-the-lone-wolf-arc]Itch.io[/url]]
